scope: transcription of the proved (B4) envelope chain; the fitted order is the only numerical claim

checks.name: `gaussDeriv_hasDerivAt`: the recursion P_{n+1} = P_n' - (y/sigma^2) P_n makes gaussDeriv(n) differentiate exactly to gaussDeriv(n+1), for n = 0..5
`gaussDeriv_envelope`: |phi^(n)(y)| <= A_n (1+|y|)^n phi(y) at every grid point, for n = 0..6, with A_n the coefficient mass
`iterDiff_eq_signSum`: the recursive iterated difference and the alternating sum over the sign cube are the same function
`envRatio_le`: envUp^2/envLo <= envConst * exp(-y^2/(4 sigma^2)) at every grid point -- the polynomial absorbed by 1+x <= e^x and both linear exponentials by completing the square
`iterDiff_mixture_envelope`: |D_b(mixture)(y)| <= prod|b_i| * envUp(sigma, R+h0, r, y) pointwise -- the LOCALISED bound, with the window widening R to R+h0
`mixture_hellinger_rate`: int Delta^2/l <= h^{2r} r^{-2r} int envUp^2/envLo at every h and r measured
checks.detail: r=2: tightest slack 7.02e+05; r=3: tightest slack 3.75e+07; r=4: tightest slack 2.53e+09
